a_voirProgramme.label: Voir Plus
a_voirProgramme.note: Homepage CTA to the events/spectacle page. Ticket calls it "Voir programme"; site text is "Voir Plus". Category links are CLASS-LESS anchors (no .btn_search): use a[href*="/category/spectacle"] and .first() because nav + footer both link here (strict-mode multi-match).

a_heroCta.label: Réservez vos billets
a_heroCta.note: Hero CTA is an <a> anchor (role=link), NOT a <button>, so getByRole("button",...) fails (element not found). Target it as a LINK: getByRole("link", { name: "Réservez vos billets" }).first() or page.locator("a.button_intro").first(). There are several carousel slides, each carrying one .button_intro (multi-match -> use .first()).

a_categorySpectacle.label: Spectacle
a_categorySpectacle.note: Nav/footer link to the Spectacle category page. Classless anchor; matches nav + footer (3 total) -> use .first() to avoid strict-mode. Tickets often call it "Voir programme" / navigate to the spectacle events list.

div_eventCard.label: Event card
div_eventCard.note: Homepage/listing event card is a div.tour_container (NOT .event-card) inside .owl-item. Use div.owl-item.active div.tour_container to target only cards in the visible carousel slide (already visible -> no scroll needed). Each card shows: venue + event name + date/time (e.g. "Théâtre Antique de Carthage Mai farouk 01 Septembre 2026 à 22:00"). IMPORTANT: the card does NOT display a price/TND - the price only appears on the event DETAIL page. So do NOT assert /TND/ on a homepage card. Use .first() to avoid strict-mode.

a_contactezNous.label: Contactez nous
a_contactezNous.note: Contact link (footer/nav), an <a> not a <button>, to https://teskerti.tn/contact. Do NOT use the hero a.button_intro "Contactez-nous!" (off-canvas/hidden at load).

ul_footerCategories.label: Footer categories list
ul_footerCategories.note: The footer lists all categories as links to /category/* (9 items). Use this instead of guessing 'footer .categories'.

a_eventTitle.label: Event title
a_eventTitle.note: The event title heading on the detail page (e.g. 'Cairokee - Carthage'). Use .col-md-8 h1 because bare h1 also matches the site header 'Teskerti'.

container_venue.label: Event venue (lieu/salle)
container_venue.note: The venue text directly under the event title, e.g. 'Théâtre Antique de Carthage : site archéologique de Carthage'. Assert it is visible and contains the expected venue name.

container_dateTime.label: Event date/time labels
container_dateTime.note: The first labels show the event date (e.g. 15/09/2026) and time (e.g. 22:00). Assert these are visible and contain the date text.

container_categoryPrices.label: Ticket categories with prices (TND)
container_categoryPrices.note: One row per ticket category with its price, e.g. 'Gradin 110TND', 'Chaise 192TND'. Assert count > 0 or that a category/price text is visible.
